AS-2 (coverage): all seven surfaces have desktop + mobile annotations and the normal, boundary, missing and failure states (a 7 x 4 coverage matrix in the spec, every cell filled or explicitly 'not applicable - why').

AS-5 (mockups): one static self-contained HTML file (no script, no external resource), fictional sample data labelled as such, desktop + phone frames for the seven surfaces.
